paras.text: There are different sources of collecting information, for example observation, interviews, questionnaires, the study of documents and the use of the internet. Information is collected on a particular topic. Written information is collected in a file. Audio and video information is collected in electronic equipment, and information obtained from the internet is saved in the computer. Whether little or much information is obtained about the topic, it is in any case necessary to keep it safe. Now the collected information is arranged in the light of several criteria. That is, written material is kept on one side, recorded information on the other side, and computer information collected on another side. Then this information is arranged on the basis of reliable sources, reliable writers, time and place, and nearness to the topic. They are given page numbers, and if necessary notes are written with a pencil. Unnecessary material is separated with respect to the topic. Now the study of the collected and arranged material is started. A good thing is that one’s study is also written down. Along with this it is also necessary that references too be written. One important thing is that collected material, whether necessary or unnecessary, should not be wasted after study and review. Arranging the material, closing it in a file, the note and date about the material should be written on top. It is possible that this very material is useful in some research or investigation. This collected and arranged material is the result of long labour and also a reliable reference; therefore its protection is necessary.

To Collect and Arrange Information — To Conclude

There are different sources of collecting information, for example observation, interviews, questionnaires, the study of documents and the use of the internet. Information is collected on a particular topic. Written information is collected in a file. Audio and video information is collected in electronic equipment, and information obtained from the internet is saved in the computer. Whether little or much information is obtained about the topic, it is in any case necessary to keep it safe. Now the collected information is arranged in the light of several criteria. That is, written material is kept on one side, recorded information on the other side, and computer information collected on another side. Then this information is arranged on the basis of reliable sources, reliable writers, time and place, and nearness to the topic. They are given page numbers, and if necessary notes are written with a pencil. Unnecessary material is separated with respect to the topic. Now the study of the collected and arranged material is started. A good thing is that one’s study is also written down. Along with this it is also necessary that references too be written. One important thing is that collected material, whether necessary or unnecessary, should not be wasted after study and review. Arranging the material, closing it in a file, the note and date about the material should be written on top. It is possible that this very material is useful in some research or investigation. This collected and arranged material is the result of long labour and also a reliable reference; therefore its protection is necessary.

Now from this study and review a conclusion can be drawn, i.e. the issue which was before us and to understand and solve which we had to collect information. Now it is to be seen what conclusion we can draw from this collected material. Every researcher, in his report, also draws such conclusions as help in understanding and solving the issue. If despite this we are not able to draw a conclusion, then it means that all our labour has gone waste and we made a mistake somewhere in collecting information. Therefore keeping all these things in mind beforehand is necessary.

sections.title: باب 5 — متن (5)

paras.text: Argument Making Based on Collected Information
paras.urdu: جمع شدہ معلومات کی بنیاد پر دلیل سازی (Argument Making Based on Collected Information)
paras.pashto: د راټولو شویو معلوماتو پر بنسټ دلیل جوړونه

paras.text: An important stage of research is also that whatever study or review has been done, argument-making be done on its basis. For example, suppose we faced this issue, that what is the basic cause of political instability in a country “A”? We collected information from different sources. Interviews of several important politicians were taken through the media. Observation was done and several factors were noted. Important books and personal diaries were collected. Information was obtained from experts through questionnaires. Most important of all, detailed information on this issue was obtained through the internet. After arranging this information it was read with thought and results were obtained. We came to know that in that country many nations live, but the political system there is unitary. From our past information and study this fact was known to us that in multinational countries the unitary form of government fails and there problems increase instead of ending. We reached this result that in country “A” the unitary form of government is the basic cause of political instability, and to end this issue there is a need for a standard federal system there. Hence we made this argument, that to bring political stability in any multinational country there is a need for a standard federation.

Interviews of several important politicians were taken through the media. Observation was done and several factors were noted. Important books and personal diaries were collected. Information was obtained from experts through questionnaires. Most important of all, detailed information on this issue was obtained through the internet. After arranging this information it was read with thought and results were obtained. We came to know that in that country many nations live, but the political system there is unitary. From our past information and study this fact was known to us that in multinational countries the unitary form of government fails and there problems increase instead of ending. We reached this result that in country “A” the unitary form of government is the basic cause of political instability, and to end this issue there is a need for a standard federal system there. Argument Making Based on Collected Information

An important stage of research is also that whatever study or review has been done, argument-making be done on its basis. For example, suppose we faced this issue, that what is the basic cause of political instability in a country “A”? We collected information from different sources. Interviews of several important politicians were taken through the media. Observation was done and several factors were noted. Important books and personal diaries were collected. Information was obtained from experts through questionnaires. Most important of all, detailed information on this issue was obtained through the internet. After arranging this information it was read with thought and results were obtained. We came to know that in that country many nations live, but the political system there is unitary. From our past information and study this fact was known to us that in multinational countries the unitary form of government fails and there problems increase instead of ending. We reached this result that in country “A” the unitary form of government is the basic cause of political instability, and to end this issue there is a need for a standard federal system there. Hence we made this argument, that to bring political stability in any multinational country there is a need for a standard federation.

After this argument-making, the next important stage is to collect real information that is consistent with this argument. Now we have to see whether, of the argument-making we have done, there is any example in the world before. For this purpose the constitutions of several multinational countries will have to be studied. For this purpose libraries, experts and the internet will have to be used. When we collect information, then we become able to obtain some results. For example, we obtained information about the constitutions and political history of Malaysia, India and America, and the results were obtained that these countries have resolved the multinational issue through a standard federation. In this way this real information proved the truth of the argument presented by us.

In research this matter is of importance, that by making an argument it is supported with real information. In this way there remains no room for error, and the fruit of the research too is obtained. However this matter is quite clear, that the internet has made this work very easy …

تحقیق میں یہ بات اہمیت کی حامل ہے کہ دلیل بنا کر اُسے حقیقی معلومات کا سہارا دیا جاتا ہے۔ اِس طرح غلطی کی گنجائش نہیں رہتی اور تحقیق کا ثمر بھی مل جاتا ہے۔ تاہم یہ بات بالکل واضح ہے کہ انٹرنیٹ نے یہ کام بہت ہی آسان کر دیا …
